name: Bellator-class dreadnought
description: The Bellator-class dreadnought, also known as the Bellator-class Star Destroyer, was a divergent design in the Mandator-series of Star Dreadnought that served as a warship in the Imperial Navy.

data.name: Bellator-class dreadnought
data.engine: 14 aft thrusters, producing more speed than Mandator-class forerunner designs.
